## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install splif_sim in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure splif_sim package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to splif_sim
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/roshkjr/splif-sim):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/roshkjr/splif-sim.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/roshkjr/splif-sim)

``` sh
$ conda install -c roshkjr splif_sim
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/splif-sim/)

``` sh
$ pip install splif_sim
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/roshkjr/splif-sim)’s
[pages](https://roshkjr.github.io/splif-sim/). Additionally you can find
package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/roshkjr/splif-sim) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/splif-sim/) respectively.
